title: Not sure what to put on your resume from a previous job?
description:
Taking notes each month about your wins at work is a great way to save time for when it’s actually time to update your resume, but what should you write? The wins you log can be as big or small as you want—the important thing is to take note while the accomplishment is fresh, which is why we suggest getting into a weekly or monthly rhythm. Don’t focus on making your resume perfect just yet. These achievements don’t have to be perfect—just focus on adding all of your wins to your main work history (or main resume). You can go back later to work in strong action verbs! #resumetips #jobsearch #jobsearching #resumebullets #careeradvice #careergrowth
